rows.grounds: indeclinable adverb of place/time; used in ritual sequence context
compound: arka (sun) + divasa (day), accusative; denotes a specific day in ritual timing
ādi (beginning) in locative sense; marks initial point in ritual sequence
anta (end) in locative sense; marks concluding point in ritual sequence
compound: puṣkara (specific term, meaning uncertain in this context) + saṃyuta (joined/combined), accusative; ritual qualification
